summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an open-market share buyback of 5,000,000 ordinary shares at an average price of 98.1064 pence per share. The purchases were executed through Goldman Sachs International as broker under an existing buyback program announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. This is a routine capital return activity and not a tender offer. The filing is a foreign private issuer report equivalent to a U.S. issuer's 8-K disclosure of share repurchases. There is no special-situation event beyond the ongoing buyback program.
